The first missile wave at about 23:00 hit a nine-storey apartment building in Desnianskyi district, where, according to the State Emergency Service, at least two people had been killed and more than 20 injured at the time of the first report, and 16 residents were evacuated; the fire spread through flats from the first to the eighth floor. The discrepancy comes from different timing and counting methods; there are no final figures. Rescue work was continuing in the morning; criminal proceedings have been opened under Art. 438 of the Criminal Code (war crimes). Private houses and apartment buildings, cars, an office building, a café, a library, a stadium and a school were also damaged. No day of mourning was declared (not mentioned in the sources).

Київ, ТЕЦ-4 і житловий будинок, 13–14 жо: Kyiv, CHP-4 and an apartment building, 13–14 October. The first missile wave at about 22:30–23:00 hit CHP-4 (according to Zelensky, one of the city’s main combined heat and power plants) and a nine-storey building in Desnianskyi district; the second series began after 04:00 and lasted several hours (according to the Kyiv Independent, explosions between 04:45 and 06:45). Fires broke out in Dniprovskyi, Darnytskyi and Shevchenkivskyi districts; DTEK introduced emergency outages in five districts, and trams and trolleybuses stopped in part of the city. According to Zelensky, at least 600,000 people in the country are without power, 26 elements of the energy system and four oil and gas facilities were damaged; the strike targeted the energy systems of Kyiv, Kyiv region and Kharkiv. Kyiv and the Air Force say partners did not pass on information about ballistic launches on either 12.10 or 13.10: the missiles were detected by radar only near the city, and the reasons are being investigated. Zelensky called the strike a “demonstrative disrespect” for the United States after the “energy ceasefire” announced by Trump and called for sanctions under Senator Lindsey Graham’s bill and additional Patriot systems. The Air Force clarified that partners had not given warning before each wave (Glavcom, 09:58).

Москва і область, ніч на 14 жовтня. За м: Moscow and the region, night of 14 October. According to Mayor Sergei Sobyanin (via RBC-Ukraine, 08:33), from 20:30 on 13.10 to 07:00 on 14.10, 493 drones flew towards the Moscow region, and another 180 were shot down closer to the capital; there were about ten waves, and TASS called it one of the largest attacks in two years (claimed by russia). Sheremetyevo, Domodedovo, Vnukovo and Zhukovsky temporarily suspended operations, Vnukovo was closed for more than eight hours; Zn.ua reports more than 400 cancelled and delayed flights.
